additional_info.subject: ID0438780-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R6 170002266]The main switch has a fault CRM:00798002319
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I assume you did all the tests that I asked but did you check if applying 24V to QA28 and QA29 in order to get the MA1 to start? And if yes, then are you able to measure 230/380 in the output of the QA1?
The idea here is that we won't be able to prove at first which one is at fault since for the Closing Failure error it can be either MA1 that is not working properly or main breaker is not closing.
My suggestion is to always start with the replacement of MA1 since it's much easier to replace and if it still doesn't work, then replace QA1. If replacing MA1 is not the solution then we need to understand if the MA1 is good or not.
I recommend you to take spare QA1 and MA1 to site.
Do you need anything else from me? If no, then I will move this ticket back to RC-PL queue.
I will wait for your feedback before sending.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hi,
Repair note:
- QA28/29 were checked on-site - they appear to be working properly; they were not replaced.
- MA1 was working, but its sound was disturbing and we recommended replacement.
- The following sets were also replaced: 3VA9908-0BB11 and 3VA9988-0AA11.
After replacing these three components, the station returned to service. I've attached the repair report.
Total work took:
- first diagnostic visit - checking the safety circuit, QA26, emergency button, and circuits - 2 hours.
- second visit with parts - 3 hours.
